title: What are the important household appliances?
desc: Major appliances, commonly referred to as white goods, include essential household items such as air conditioners, dishwashers, clothes dryers, drying cabinets, freezers, refrigerators, kitchen stoves, water heaters, washing machines, trash compactors, microwave ovens, and induction cookers.

title: Which supply is used in home appliances?
desc: Alternating current (AC) power is the standard for residential electrical systems in many regions. The electricity supplied by utility companies is primarily AC, and homes are usually equipped with AC outlets and appliances designed to operate on AC power.

title: Which appliances use the least electricity?
desc: Hair dryers, ovens, and space heaters consume very few kilowatt hours, and even refrigerators are energy efficient. This is particularly true for newer refrigerators, which use only 30 kilowatt hours per month.

title: Do built-in ovens get hot on the outside?
desc: Yes, built-in ovens can become hot on the exterior during operation. it's essential to exercise caution and avoid touching the outside, especially if young children are present. Some ovens are designed with better insulation to reduce external heat.

title: How long can a dishwasher sit without being used?
desc: Your dishwasher can remain unused for a while without any issues. However, if left completely unused for more than a year, it may develop problems. To keep it in good condition, it's best to run your dishwasher a few times throughout the year.
